oneLine: Koolking Industries files IPO papers to raise Rs 300 crore.

sources.title: HVAC components maker Koolking Industries files IPO papers, plans to raise Rs 300 crore via fresh issue

synopsis: HVAC components maker Koolking Industries has filed draft papers with SEBI to raise funds through an initial public offering. The public issue comprises a fresh issue of Rs 300 crore and an offer-for-sale of 30.5 lakh shares by promoters. The company may also consider raising up to Rs 60 crore through a pre-IPO placement, which would reduce the fresh issue size accordingly. Incorporated in 2008, the Punjab-based company plans to utilize Rs 138.4 crore of the net fresh issue proceeds to set up new manufacturing units, Rs 14.5 crore for new machinery and equipment, and Rs 60 crore for working capital requirements. Keynote Financial Services has been appointed as the merchant banker for managing the IPO.
